breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions. The incomplete prompt specified both Dirichlet and Periodic conditions. The agent removed the incorrect periodic condition and only included the Dirichlet condition: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions on all four edges of the square: set u equal to x at every boundary point.' This matches the correction made in the ground truth.
